resource_load.note: Single SELECT query on indexed unique composite key
SELECT watch + SELECT user_blocking + INSERT/UPDATE watch + UPDATE repository
SELECT watch + DELETE/UPDATE watch + UPDATE repository
1 search query + N descriptor builds (mitigated by ephemeral cache)

performance_issues.description: GetPackageDescriptors iterates over each version and performs multiple queries per version (properties, files, blobs), though mitigated by EphemeralCache for shared entities
performance_issues.impact: For pages with many packages from different owners/repos, multiple DB round-trips per result
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch-load properties and files for all version IDs in a single query

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch-load package_property and package_file records for all version IDs returned by SearchVersions
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce DB round-trips from O(N*3) to O(3) for N results
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add batch methods like GetPropertiesByVersionIDs and GetFilesByVersionIDs

resource_load.note: Middleware loads full descriptor (version lookup + package + owner + creator + properties + files + blobs)
Package lookup + get all descriptors + transaction with multiple deletes + notifications

performance_issues.description: GetAllPackageDescriptors loads all versions then builds descriptor for each one individually
performance_issues.impact: For packages with many versions, this causes many DB round-trips before the actual deletion
performance_issues.recommendation: Since descriptors are only needed for notifications, consider a lighter-weight approach for the delete path

optimization_recommendations.description: For deletion, only minimal descriptor info is needed for notifications. Use a lighter query that doesn't load all files/blobs/properties
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce pre-deletion query load significantly for packages with many versions
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add a GetMinimalPackageDescriptors method that only loads package, version, owner, creator
